body:
Humans should set up a model, including its API key, from the Settings page, without opening a command line.

## Problem
Today a model's endpoint key comes only from an environment variable named by `key_env` in `~/.config/solace/config.toml`. The Solace server starts from the desktop app, so it never sees variables set in a shell. The model is then silently missing from the model list, and the only fix is editing system environment files.

## Wanted
- On the Settings page, a human can add or edit a model (label, agent, model id, endpoint base URL) and paste its API key.
- Solace keeps the key itself: the OS keychain where available, else a file under `~/.config/solace/` readable only by the user. Never in `config.toml`, never shown again after saving.
- When Solace launches the agent (Codex: `endpoint_args` in `src/board.rs` already passes `env_key`), it sets that variable on the agent's process from the stored key.
- `local()` in `src/board/agents.rs` treats a stored key as available. `key_env` keeps working for people who prefer environment variables.
- A model that can't start stays in the model list with its reason, such as "No key yet; add one in Settings", instead of disappearing.

## Notes
- Real case that prompted this: Command Code (`https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1`, model `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`, OpenAI Responses API).
- Optional nice touch: a "Test connection" button that calls the endpoint's `/models` and reports whether the model id exists and supports `/responses`.
title: Set up models and their keys from Settings
